description: This Java source file defines the 'EventSenderImpl' class, which is an implementation of a client for sending event messages to an Eclipse Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It includes methods for creating senders, constructing AMQP target addresses, and sending messages with delivery semantics, as well as tracing support.

classes.name: EventSenderImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for publishing event messages to a Hono server, extending AbstractDownstreamSender.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target AMQP address for sending events, based on tenantId and optional deviceId.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the event endpoint constant indicating the message target.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Derives the target address based on tenantId and deviceId.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EventSenderImpl instance with a ProtonSender, connected to the specified tenant, and sets up close hooks.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, with overloads for providing a parent SpanContext.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message, marking it as durable, and waits for acknowledgment.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Initiates a new OpenTracing span for message forwarding, tagging it as a producer.
